card.name: Pieces of ALL-CAPS label words
card.fires_on: Word starts like IND and REL inside capitalized label text, and the word OF in all-caps phrases. It fires on INDIVIDUALS, INDICATED and RELIABLE written in capitals.

modes.label: IND in capitals
modes.description: The first piece IND of INDIVIDUALS or INDICATED in all-caps warning text.
modes.example: THERE HAVE BEEN REPORTS OF<< IND>>IVIDUALS WITH A HISTORY OF

modes.label: REL in capitals
modes.description: The first piece REL of RELIABLE or RELISTOR in capitalized headings or text.

modes.label: OF in capitals
modes.description: The word OF in all-caps phrases such as years of age or estimate of.
modes.example: NOT RECOMMENDED FOR CHILDREN UNDER 2 YEARS<< OF>> AGE.
